subject: How to insert R value into a form

messages.author: 066a0ceb2819d0e3
messages.subject: How to insert R value into a form
parts:
At the beginning of my code I define startDate

startDate <- ifelse(is.null(GET$startDate),Sys.Date(),GET$startDate)

and it works fine, but I want to use startDate as the default value in
my form.

Date (mm/dd/yyyy)<INPUT TYPE="text" NAME="startDate" SIZE=25
value=startDate>

The above doesn't work because it shows "startDate" instead of the
value of startDate. Can anyone tell me the how to do this?

TIA, Roger

messages.subject: Re: How to insert R value into a form
parts:
I still can't figure this out and it seems like it should be trivially
easy, so I have created a small example in hopes that someone will
help me out. You will see that I create a variable with a string
value of "100' and I am trying to put that into a text box as a
default value. It works when I hardcode "100", but not when I try to
use a variable. Any suggestions on how to do this would be
appreciated.

Thanks,

Roger

<%
testValue <- "100"
cat(paste("test value is ", testValue))
%>
<br>
<html>
<body>
test box 1<INPUT TYPE="text" NAME="startDate" value="100">
<br>
test box 2<INPUT TYPE="text" NAME="startDate" value=" <% testValue
%>">
<br>
</body>
</html>

Sorry about not replying sooner. I've been away from the computer for
a week (and I LOVED it), so I'm catching up on email.

You will want to use the <%= and %> delimiters to expand values in
your template. This is all explained in the brew documentation which
you can get at by typing ?brew at the R prompt.

Jeff
